title: Pointwise scalar extension of a constant module presheaf
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], Y a scheme [def-pc-scheme], g:Y → Spec(k), and M a k-module. Let P be the presheaf pullback of the constant M presheaf along picardConstantRingMap [lem-sc-picard-constant-sections-tensor-basis]. There exist O_Y(V)-linear equivalences q_V: O_Y(V) tensor_k M ≃ P(V) for every open V. For a restriction i:U → V in Y.Opensᵒᵖ, a in O_Y(U), and s in M, res_P(q_U(a tensor s)) = q_V(res_O(a) tensor s). This identifies the chosen abstract left adjoint with sectionwise scalar extension, before tensoring with any coefficient module.

source.place: Tag 006R, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict-presheaves; constant-module specialization of the representing-object step in lem-sc-picard-constant-tensor-balanced-sections (Tag 0BED). Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/006R and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED.

proof.text: Construct E(V)=O_Y(V) tensor_k M using ModuleCat.extendScalars. Define restriction by extending s ↦ 1 tensor s through the scalar-extension adjunction. Naturality of scalarMap proves k-linearity. The adjunction formula sends a tensor s to res(a) tensor s; scalar-extension hom_ext proves identity and composition. These are the actual private definitions extensionRestriction and extensionPresheaf, with no postponed data.

For each structure-module presheaf H, construct inverse maps (E → H) ↔ (constant M → pushforward H) by applying ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.homEquiv at every open. Evaluation at 1 tensor s respects restriction by naturality of the original morphism and res(1)=1. The inverse respects restriction on the generators 1 tensor s by naturality of the constant-presheaf morphism; ExtendScalars.hom_ext extends this to all tensors. The componentwise adjunction inverses prove that these maps are mutually inverse. Postcomposition naturality is definitional. Thus extensionCorepresentableBy is a genuine CorepresentableBy object.

The existing pullbackPushforwardAdjunction corepresents the same functor. Functor.CorepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso gives E ≅ P. Evaluate that isomorphism at each open and convert it to a linear equivalence. Its naturality and the proved extensionRestriction_tmul formula give the required restriction equality. Empty opens and zero M require no exceptional cases: all constructions are scalar-extension Hom equivalences and pure-tensor formulas.

lean.statement:
def picardConstantScalarExtensionSections
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (Y : Scheme.{w})
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (M : ModuleCat.{w} k) (V : Y.Opens) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars (scalarMap g V)).obj M ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, V)]
      ((PresheafOfModules.pullback (picardConstantRingMap k Y g)).obj
        (picardConstantVector k Y M)).obj (op V)
